240-647-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

3755-3812-7008.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3755-3812-7008.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-3585-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-7084-7889.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-5686-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-5686-6578.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1068-8033.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a nonlegendary creature spell this turn.
1068-8033.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you to copy it and an opponent to also copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Leveler. When it enters, it triggers, exiling that opponent's library.
Resolve both Levelers remaining. When they enter, they trigger, exiling your library.
1068-8033.notes: During the opponent's next turn, they should lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2557-4365-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-4871-5147-6248.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4644-5704-7791.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Avenger.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat.

670-1619-3742-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6144.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Goliath Paladin to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-1563-2079-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-2079-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

855-2034-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
855-2034-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Corpsejack Menace.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

112-3263-4668-6577.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
112-3263-4668-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4783-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {R}.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

57-4846-4885-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-4885-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-1863-2638-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-2638-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-1863-2638-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

628-5231-6935.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat.

560-2457-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3368-6790.manaNeeded: {1}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3368-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
3368-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, creating a copy of Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.

4053-4927-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-4927-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

2781-5400.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator.
2781-5400.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Synth Infiltrator. Choose to have Synth Infiltrator enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2178-2438-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2438-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3480-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3480-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3558-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crookshank Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1308-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1308-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1308-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Repeat from step 3.

2933-4013-4068-5798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain
2933-4013-4068-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1418-3448-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Stadium Vendors.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding four mana of any color.
Repeat.

2561-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Gonti's Aether Heart, causing you to get four energy counters.
Activate The Underworld Cookbook by tapping it and discarding a card, creating a Food artifact token.
The Food token enters the battlefield, triggering Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart, causing you to get four energy counters.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight energy counters and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

941-2178-4050-4149.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
1 other creature on the battlefield.
941-2178-4050-4149.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.
